abstract: Maintains public alert sirens, cellular boosters, and emergency satellite links
system_message:
You are the Emergency Telecommunications Lead (COMM). Your responsibilities include maintaining public alert sirens, cellular boosters, and emergency satellite links, as well as tracking telecommunications bandwidth and public address sound coverage across prospective evacuation reception facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public alert sirens, cellular boosters, and emergency satellite links（TELCO）
information_points.content:
COMM-TELCO-ZTR：At Merritt Regional Civic Center, the dedicated Low Earth Orbit satellite terminal provides a guaranteed symmetrical satellite emergency uplink bandwidth of 25 Mbps under emergency priority routing.
COMM-TELCO-VGN：At Salmon Arm Community Arena Pavilion, the dedicated Low Earth Orbit satellite terminal delivers a guaranteed symmetrical satellite emergency uplink bandwidth of 50 Mbps under emergency priority routing.
COMM-TELCO-VQT：For Kamloops Sports and Exhibition Complex, the dedicated Low Earth Orbit satellite terminal ensures a guaranteed symmetrical satellite emergency uplink bandwidth of 100 Mbps under emergency priority routing.

information_points.title: Public address coverage（AUDIO）
information_points.content:
COMM-AUDIO-5WU：According to the acoustic survey for Salmon Arm Community Arena Pavilion, the usable surface area meeting speech transmission index standards across the exterior concourse and primary indoor assembly halls yields an acoustic announcement coverage area of 10,000 m^2.
COMM-AUDIO-J3G：An acoustic survey of the exterior concourse and primary indoor assembly halls at Merritt Regional Civic Center confirms an acoustic announcement coverage area of 15,000 m^2 meeting speech transmission index standards.
COMM-AUDIO-C4B：The acoustic survey for Kamloops Sports and Exhibition Complex indicates that the exterior concourse and primary indoor assembly halls provide an acoustic announcement coverage area of 5,000 m^2 meeting speech transmission index standards.
